evidence.environment: Near-wearer conditions (indicative; the sensor is biased by the wearer's breath and head heat): CO2 612 ppm, temperature 21.4 C, relative humidity 38%

risk.severity_justification: The worker was near-missed by an object, which could have resulted in injury.
risk.likelihood_justification: The worker was actively moving an arm with a tool, increasing the likelihood of an object striking the head.

immediate.description: The worker was actively moving an arm with a tool, increasing the likelihood of an object striking the head.

root_five_whys: Why was the worker moving the arm with a tool? Because the worker was performing a task.
Why was the worker performing the task? Because the worker was following instructions.
Why were the instructions given? Because the supervisor was directing the worker.
Why was the supervisor directing the worker? Because the supervisor was managing the crew.
Why was the supervisor managing the crew? Because the supervisor was responsible for the project.

corrective_actions.description: Ensure workers are aware of the risks associated with moving arms with tools near the head.
Implement a system to ensure workers are trained on safe practices when using tools near the head.
Review and update the site-specific safe work procedures to include specific guidance on the use of tools near the head.
